Wenzhou Longchang Chemical Co., Ltd. is a leading chemical company located in the Lantian Industrial Zone in Yongzhong Town, Longwan District, China. With years of experience in the industry, we have established ourselves as a trusted and reliable supplier of high-quality chemical products.

At Wenzhou Longchang Chemical Co., Ltd., we specialize in the production and distribution of a wide range of chemicals, including industrial chemicals, specialty chemicals, and raw materials for various industries. Our state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities and stringent quality control measures ensure that all our products meet the highest standards of purity and performance.

We take pride in our commitment to environmental sustainability and safety in all aspects of our operations. Our team of skilled professionals is dedicated to delivering exceptional customer service and building long-term relationships with our clients.

As a customer-focused company, we strive to provide innovative solutions and customized products to meet the specific needs of our clients. Whether you require bulk quantities of chemicals for industrial applications or specialty chemicals for specialized processes, Wenzhou Longchang Chemical Co., Ltd. is your trusted partner for all your chemical requirements.

Contact us today to learn more about our products and services. We look forward to serving you and exceeding your expectations with our superior quality chemicals and unmatched customer support.
